Context: Existing pattern of recovery:

- (iii) Failure to repay.If the officials fail to repay the balance of the advance on or before the date of retirement, Government may enforce recovery from retirement/ death gratuity or by sale of the house or in any other manner.
- (iv) Manner of recovery.Recovery will be effected through monthly pay/ leave salary or subsistence allowance bills. Recovery cannot be postponed without the prior concurrence of Government.
